start: Owner on a member's page; the gym has saved diet plans and this member has none

steps.action: Scroll to the section "Diet plan"
user_sees: "No diet plan sent yet. Members see their plan in the MettleUp app (Gym → Diet plan) after they check in at the gym once."
Button "Send a diet plan"
must_not: A plan of another member shown here
An endless "Loading…"

steps.action: Tap "Send a diet plan"
user_sees: Sheet "Send a diet plan to <member name>"
"Your gym’s diet plans" with each plan and "Send"
"Or make one for them"
must_not: Withdrawn plans offered

steps.action: Tap a plan
user_sees: "Sending…" on that row, the sheet closes, a toast "“<plan name>” sent to <member name>."
The plan listed in the section with a button to stop sending it
must_not: The plan sent to another member
Other members who had the plan losing it
Two sends from a double tap

start: Owner on a member's page, sheet "Send a diet plan to <member name>"

steps.action: Under "Or make one for them" (reads "Make one for them" when the gym has no plan to offer) tap "Start from a ready-made plan" ("Veg or non-veg, for fat loss, muscle gain or keeping your weight")
user_sees: The ready-made list, then the editor "New diet plan" with this member already picked
must_not: The new plan saved for nobody
The new plan sent to every member

steps.action: Or tap "Write a new plan" ("Every meal yourself"), fill it and tap "Save plan"
user_sees: The plan saved and listed for this member
must_not: The plan missing from the Diet plans page

steps.action: Open "Send a diet plan" for a member who already has one of the plans
user_sees: That plan with the pill "Already sent"; it cannot be tapped
must_not: The plan sent twice

steps.action: Open the member page on a gym that is not online, and on a gym whose server lacks diet plans
user_sees: "Diet plans are kept on your gym’s server. Put your gym online first (Settings → Sign-in & data)."
"Diet plans are not switched on for your gym yet."
must_not: A "Send a diet plan" button that can never work

steps.action: Tap a plan with the internet off
user_sees: In the sheet: the server's words, or "Could not send this plan. Try again."
must_not: The toast "sent" when nothing was sent

start: Owner on a member's page; the member has one plan sent by name and one through their membership plan

steps.action: Read the section "Diet plan"
user_sees: Both plan names; the second with " · through their membership plan"
must_not: A plan from a membership that has ended still listed

steps.action: Tap the stop button on the plan sent by name ("Stop sending <plan> to <member>")
user_sees: A toast "<member name> no longer gets “<plan name>”."
The plan leaves the section
must_not: Other members losing the plan
The whole plan withdrawn
Two saves from a double tap leaving the plan in a wrong state

steps.action: Tap "Send a diet plan" and send the same plan again
user_sees: It can be sent again (not "Already sent")
must_not: The plan stuck as "Already sent"

steps.action: Send a plan to this member, then open the member's app
user_sees: The member sees the plan under Gym → Diet plan, after they have checked in at the gym once
must_not: Another member seeing this member's plan
The section shown to a login that may not send plans
A plan shown to the member with no word that it is not medical advice when it came from a ready-made plan
